somersault.fade: opacity 1 through frame1 then fade to0 across frame2; clear after lifetime

jump_kick.fade: opacity 1 through frame1 then fade to0 across frame2; clear after lifetime

melee.fade: opacity 1 through frame1 then fade to0 across frame2; clear after lifetime

anchor_policy: somersault uses grounded actor origin minus engine height; kick/melee use per-frame hand/foot contact point. Use local coordinates and mirror offsets when facing left.
spawn_policy: spawn once at active attack entry even on miss; not once per input poll or overlapping target
damage_policy: pure visual FX; no new damage hits. Reach increase must be configured separately in existing attack hitboxes.
replaces: previous procedural somersault effect; disable old effect when new textures are used
hit_spark_policy: separate confirmed-hit effect; can coexist; do not substitute this for impact spark
notes: Offsets and timing are initial proposals based on adopted assets, verify against actual runtime motions.

Do not enlarge depth lane indiscriminately or add a second FX damage hit.
